description: Ines sends a message in the group chat about the shared birthday dinner, asking who will host.
Kwame sends a message in the group chat: 'Hey everyone, I'm away until Friday so can't host, but happy to help figure out details when I'm back. Let me know what you decide!'
Kwame's message arrives in the group chat and is available to all members, but Ines has not yet observed it.
Bea looks at her work schedule on her phone.
Bea sees her work schedule on her phone, showing her shifts for the upcoming weekend.
Bea scrolls to Sunday October 11 on her phone's calendar and sees her shift: she works the night shift starting at 10pm.
Ines observes Kwame's message in the group chat.
Ines opens the group chat and reads Kwame's message.
Bea scrolls to Friday October 9 and Saturday October 10 on her phone's calendar.
Bea sees her calendar for Friday October 9 and Saturday October 10 on her phone.
Bea switches to the group chat app on her phone and sees the new messages from Ines and Kwame.
Bea's message is sent in the group chat.
Bea's message arrives in the group chat and is available to all members.
Ines opens the group chat app on her phone and sees the unread messages.
Ines reads Kwame's message and Bea's message in the group chat.
Ines types and sends a message in the group chat: 'Thanks for the updates, guys. Let's decide on a host by Friday night so we can plan accordingly.'
